note: Adult (>=50 kg, no organ impairment) outpatient daily-dose ceilings, mg/day. Advisory only — the aggregation flag is a prompt to check the combined molecule load across co-prescribed products, not a hard contraindication. Seed set = paracetamol + the NSAIDs and decongestant stimulants that recur in Indian fever/pain combination brands. 1.1 (Deterministic-Citations PRD §5.6, V-signed-off 22 Jul): each entry carries `derivation` ('external' = corpus-verified, resolves to a published authority; 'llm' = internally-derived, no corpus verification) and, where external, a `citation` to the underlying source. NOTE these are ADVISORY thresholds — a citation records where a concordant threshold was found; several entries were marked 'contradicts' by the strict verifier because the corpus states a DIFFERENT (usually higher, indication-specific) maximum, which is a claim-granularity artifact, not a data defect (V ruling). citation/derivation are additive metadata; they never enter scoring.
